```{r optional setup, include = FALSE, eval = !params$run.pipeline }

### Precursor

params$precursor.include <- TRUE  # TRUE, FALSE

params$mzmine.mz.tol.pos <- params$mz_tolerance
params$mzmine.rt.tol.pos <- params$rt_tolerance
params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos <- 5
params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos.percent <- 0.2

params$mzmine.mz.tol.neg <- params$mzmine.mz.tol.pos
params$mzmine.rt.tol.neg <- params$mzmine.rt.tol.pos
params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.neg <- params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos
params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos.percent <- params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos.percent

```

```{r set environment variables}

path.output <-
  paste0(params$path.result, "03_03_Preprocessing/")

if (!dir.exists(path.output)) dir.create(path.output)

path_lib_pos = paste0(path.output, "library_MS1_", params$method, "_pos.csv")
path_lib_neg = paste0(path.output, "library_MS1_", params$method, "_neg.csv")

path_mzML_pos = params$path.mzml.pos
path_mzML_neg = params$path.mzml.neg

mzmine_mz_tol_pos = params$mzmine.mz.tol.pos
mzmine_mz_tol_bigger_pos = params$mzmine.mz.tol.pos+0.006
mzmine_rt_tol_pos = params$mzmine.rt.tol.pos
mzmine_rt_tol_bigger_pos = params$mzmine.rt.tol.pos+0.2
mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_pos = params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos
mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_pos_percent = params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos.percent

mzmine_mz_tol_neg = params$mzmine.mz.tol.neg
mzmine_mz_tol_bigger_neg = params$mzmine.mz.tol.neg+0.006
mzmine_rt_tol_neg = params$mzmine.rt.tol.neg
mzmine_rt_tol_bigger_neg = params$mzmine.rt.tol.neg+0.2
mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_neg = params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.neg
mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_neg_percent = params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.neg.percent

```

### Preprocessing using MZmine
#### POS
```{r generate library pos, eval = params$run.pos}

precursor.file <- paste0(params$path.result, "02_Extract_precursor/precursor_annotation_pos.rds")

if ( params$precursor.include & file.exists(precursor.file) ){

  prec.lib <-
    readRDS( precursor.file) %>%
    filter( is.na(Library.rt) ) %>%
    mutate( Library.rt = rt,
            Library.mz = mz ) %>%
    select( Library.mz, Library.rt, Library.name)

  print( paste0("POS: Precursors were used for preprocessing, ", gsub(".rds", ".xlsx", precursor.file)) )
  
} else {
  
  prec.lib <- 
    data.frame()
  
}


lib.to.use <-
    bind_rows(params$lib[[params$method]]$pos, 
              prec.lib,
              params$lib.is[[params$method]]$pos %>%
                select( Library.mz, Library.rt, Library.name)) %>%
    select( Library.mz, Library.rt, Library.name) %>%
    dplyr::rename( mz = Library.mz,
                   rt = Library.rt,
                   name = Library.name)

output.file <- paste0(path.output, "peaktable_targeted_pos.csv")
library.file <- paste0(path.output, "library_MS1_", params$method, "_pos.csv")

write.table( lib.to.use, 
             sep = ";",
             row.names = FALSE,
             file = library.file )

print( paste0("POS peaktable for internal standards was saved as: ", output.file), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("Library file: ", library.file), quote = FALSE)
print( "MZmine parameters used in positive mode:")

print( paste0("mzmine_mz_tol_pos = ", mzmine_mz_tol_pos), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("mzmine_mz_tol_bigger_pos = ", mzmine_mz_tol_bigger_pos), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("mzmine_rt_tol_pos = ", mzmine_rt_tol_pos), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("mzmine_rt_tol_bigger_pos = ", mzmine_rt_tol_bigger_pos), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_pos = ", mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_pos), quote = FALSE)
print( paste0("mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_pos_percent = ", mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_pos_percent), quote = FALSE)

```


```{r generate xml pos, echo = TRUE, eval = params$run.pos}

prepare_mzmine_xml(
    type = "peak",
    path_mzML = path_mzML_pos,
    path_output = path.output,
    mode = "pos",
    path_lib = path_lib_pos,
    mzmine_mz_tol = mzmine_mz_tol_pos,
    mzmine_mz_tol_bigger = mzmine_mz_tol_bigger_pos,
    mzmine_rt_tol = mzmine_rt_tol_pos,
    mzmine_rt_tol_bigger = mzmine_rt_tol_bigger_pos,
    mzmine_min_peaks_in_row = mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_pos,
    mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_percent = mzmine_min_peaks_in_row_pos_percent
  )

```

```{r data preprocessing pos, include = FALSE, eval = params$run.pos}


if ( file.exists( "/home/projects/ku_00007/" ) & !file.exists(output.file) ) {
  
  system( paste0( 'bash ', path.mzmine, ' ', path.output, 'MZMine_parameters_pos.xml') )
  
} else if ( !file.exists(output.file)){
  
  # system("cmd.exe", input = paste0( params$path.mzmine,
  #                                   ' "', paste0(path.output, "MZMine_parameters_pos.xml"), '"'))
  
  system("cmd.exe", input = paste0( params$path.mzmine,
                                    ' -batch "', paste0(path.output, "MZMine_parameters_pos.xml"), '"' ))
  
}

```
